title: PlaneMem workbench project overview
description: Complete overview operation model for POST /v1/workbench/query. Source-only prerequisite for the full multiplexed OpenAPI route; other operations are separate models. Standalone schema.
$comment: Runtime additionally checks count sums, preview length=min(total,cap), unique IDs/layers, finite Date.parse and expiry comparisons. Does not impose ULIDs or canonical timestamps where the current parser only checks text/Date.parse. No server response-byte/depth cap or validator/generator/runtime evidence is claimed.

time.description: Finite Date.parse required; parser retains original text, including database submillisecond precision. Not necessarily canonical millisecond UTC.

context.description: Normalized saved preview. Arbitrary JSON content is deliberately optional in the shared parser: SQL brief supplies it, ordinary previews omit it. Unknown row fields such as updated_at are stripped; known content is preserved without nested business parsing or byte cap. Saved expiry/status is not source-chain freshness.

brief.description: SQL chooses one unexpired confirmed L0 by High/Medium/other priority, updated_at descending then ID. Parser rejects expiry<read_at, tolerates equality after JS millisecond truncation; SQL requires actual future expiry. Null if none. No recursive source revalidation.

layerSummary.description: Each proposed/expired<=count; they may overlap, so their sum may exceed count. Saved confidence mean covers all visible nonarchived statuses, including excluded/expired; no source-quality proof.

session.description: SQL started_at used for ordering is stripped. Counts query runs/tools by session_id; summary does not include their content or evaluate tool execution permission.

conflict.description: Visible open conflict metadata only; copied field values are not exposed in overview.

data.description: Normalized complete data. project_id equals authenticated project at repository boundary. active_work_items=todo+in_progress+in_review+blocked; total=active+completed+cancelled. Sum each layer count/proposed/expired equals corresponding total. Each preview has unique nonempty IDs and exactly min(total,3/2/4/3) rows. Expired preview status=expired OR expires_at<=read_at; proposed/expired may overlap. read_at is one statement snapshot; last_activity_at=max visible work updated_at or project updated_at, not all-table activity. SQL layers sorted L0..L4; shared parser accepts any unique layer order.

envelope.description: Built-in repository HTTP envelope, selected current trace and seven ordered table sources. No ETag/cursor/write metadata or dedicated response byte cap. Generic getProjectOverview SDK is weaker on outer fields: permits extensions and any valid source refs/nonblank trace, compares present data scope, parses complete data, but does not require exact trace/source set. No dedicated bounded-json/client total deadline added here.

x-runtime-boundaries.http: Body {operation:overview} only. Existing authenticated workbench POST, generic pre-auth1MiB JSON and traceparent before x-trace-id. Verified client not required for this read; actual Policy context.read and decision audit/generic rate limit apply. Expected actor/client headers, when supplied, match verified identity; raw identity headers do not grant access. No dedicated query/media/encoding/cache-condition rejection or write-header parse for this path; success cache bypassed.
x-runtime-boundaries.query: One SQL from scoped undeleted readable project. Missing/hidden project404, no synthetic zero summary. Excludes deleted/restricted work/context rows as capability permits. Conflict visibility follows extant source row and maximum sensitivity; null source hidden. Active sessions=running. Separate aggregates avoid multiplicative joins, but no cross-request snapshot. SQL ::int count overflow fails database query instead of returning a rounded count.
x-runtime-boundaries.result: Repository converts top-level Date values then shared parser strips known-object extensions and verifies totals/selection; malformed overview500 false. Brief content is preserved as arbitrary JSON, not independently bounded or freshness-checked. No response size, dedicated transaction timeout or two-slot handler cap; not the limits of later work-item SDK/MCP reads.
x-runtime-boundaries.errors: INVALID_JSON/INVALID_INPUT400 false; initial UNAUTHENTICATED401/DENIED403; hidden/missing project NOT_FOUND404 false; RATE_LIMITED429 true; WORKBENCH_OVERVIEW_INVALID500 false; unexpected INTERNAL_ERROR500 true; WORKBENCH_DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE/WORKBENCH_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE/AUDIT_PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE503 true. Generic ApiGateway replaces trace_unknown from repository DB errors with request trace.
x-runtime-boundaries.sdk: getProjectOverview uses ordinary json transport/envelope then parseWorkbenchOverview. No per-call options or new total response limit. Fetch default30s abort begins after credential acquisition, ordinary JSON parse has no explicit byte/media/exact-trace gate; generic envelope does not require exact supplied trace or seven postgres refs. Full overview data parsing and present scope equality still apply. This schema documents built-in wire, not proof that SDK enforces every wire constraint.
